attchmntText: Krishana Phoschem Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Krishana Phoschem Limited informs the National Stock Exchange that the earnings conference call for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, was held on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, at 12.00 Noon. The audio recording of this call is available on the company’s website at the link https://krishnaphoschem.com/financial-and-reports.html#webcast. This intimation is pursuant to Regulation 30 and 46 read with clause 15 of Para A of Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI Listing Regulations, 2015. The notice follows a previous intimation dated July 11th, 2026. The communication was signed by Anil Sharma, Company Secretary, with membership number A25045.

attchmntText: Krishana Phoschem Limited has informed the Exchange about Presentation
voiceSummary: Krishana Phoschem Limited filed a result presentation for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, with the National Stock Exchange of India. The company reported a half-year revenue of 1,235 crore rupees, marking a 23% year-on-year increase. EBITDA rose 56% to 216 crore rupees, while profit after tax reached an all-time high of 125 crore rupees, up 96% year-on-year. Earnings per share grew 96% to 4.04 rupees. The company highlighted a 70,000 MT green ammonia supply agreement with the Solar Energy Corporation of India for ten years. Management noted that the Government of India approved 62,370 crore rupees under the Nutrient Based Subsidy scheme for the Rabi 2026–27 season. The presentation also outlined strategic risk mitigation measures regarding raw material costs and supply chain disruptions.

attchmntText: Krishana Phoschem Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Krishana Phoschem Ltd submitted newspaper cuttings for the publication of unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The results were approved in a meeting held on November 14, 2026. Advertisements were published in The Financial Express, Business Remedies, and Nafa Nuksan on November 15, 2026. The announcement includes a QR code and weblink to access complete financial results. The information is also available on the company website at www.krishnaphoschem.com. This filing is made in terms of Regulation 47 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The document was signed by Anil Sharma, Company Secretary, on November 15, 2026.

attchmntText: Krishana Phoschem Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Krishana Phoschem Limited board approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Revenue from operations was 70,254.28 lakhs for the quarter and 1,23,484.84 lakhs for the half year. Profit before tax stood at 10,438.17 lakhs for the quarter and 16,498.11 lakhs for the half year. Net profit was 7,785.79 lakhs for the quarter and 12,495.25 lakhs for the half year. Earnings per share were 2.52 rupees for the quarter and 4.04 rupees for the half year. The company executed a stock split of equity shares from face value of 10 rupees to 2 rupees, effective 3rd July 2026. Total assets were 2,26,081.37 lakhs as of 30th September 2026. The independent auditor issued a clean review report.
